name: 60446 · Romeoville, IL
findings: ZIP 60446 (Romeoville) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60446 (Romeoville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60446 (Romeoville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
